title: Vast station feature
description: A 900px warm-white product stage: a gigantic pale-grey product name fills the width behind a circular dial of fine tick marks with one orange needle at twelve o'clock, and the 3D object sits in the middle of the dial. Small mono labels (name and launch year) top-left, a right-aligned spec table top-right on desktop, a two-line headline and a 'Learn more' link bottom-left whose chevron slides forward and back on a loop. On phones the name moves to the top and the dial sits below it.
notes: fixed 900px tall at every width, like the original (not window-sized)
the dial is drawn with CSS (a repeating conic gradient masked to a ring); the object in it is the `media` slot (a 3D render, PNG or canvas, about 3:4)
the huge word uses the card colour on the page colour: keep those two close
the spec table is hidden on phones
name: vastspace-station
